c2Supersense.label: Constellation 2 after the Burst
c2Supersense.reason: A Constellation 2 window after his Burst whose size grows with the number of enemies hit.

c6Stacks.label: Constellation 6 stacks
c6Stacks.reason: Stacks from Hypersense, which other party members' reactions or Nightsoul-aligned hits set off.

c2BurstHitStack.label: Constellation 2 stacks from Burst hits
c2BurstHitStack.reason: The bonus grows with the enemies his Burst hits, up to four, and only inside the window after the Burst, whose switch is off. It was checked once with it and its other switch on against Genshin Optimizer and agreed; no case commits it.
